description: React component for a Kanban column, handling display, inline editing, and deletion, with integration to context and drag-and-drop.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates new column title to ensure it's not empty and differs from current.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Begins inline editing of the column title.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the new column title after validation, updates via context, and shows toast messages.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for the title input, triggering save or cancel.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets state to show delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Confirms and performs column deletion, showing a toast notification.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })

ctags.signature: ({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
